_comment: Load tuning for kirk's M5 MacBook Air (32 GB). Sampling (temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, top-k 0, min-p 0.0, reasoning effort) is model-level and lives in the agent configs, not here — it is identical on every machine. Load tuning is machine-level: on the 32 GB Air, eval batch 2048 Metal-OOMs at 64K context during decode (weights fit, activation buffers do not) — eval 512 fixes it without giving up context.
